notes.title: v0.0.59 - General updates
notes.notes:
It's been a while since the last update. Added some performance tweaks and visual popups showing the score for each feature.

As always, your feedback helps shape the game, so let me know what you think of the changes. Thanks for playing and for being part of the community!

notes.title: v0.0.57 🚀 Renderer Support for Older Hardware + Steam Rich Presence!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

We've just rolled out a renderer update to support older Windows hardware, ensuring smoother gameplay for more players! 🎮

In addition, Steam Rich Presence is now live! Your friends can now see real-time updates on your game modes while you play. Plus, we've included some minor fixes to keep everything running smoothly.

Thanks for the continued feedback, and enjoy the update! 😎

notes.title: v0.0.54 - 🎵 Update: Preferences & Performance Tweaks! 🎮
notes.notes:
I’m excited to bring you another update with some handy new features and improvements:

What’s New:

[list]
[*] Preferences Menu (ESC Key): You can now adjust and save music, sound effects, and master volume levels directly from the preferences menu. 🎧
[*] Performance Tweaks: A few optimizations have been made to keep things running smoother.
[*] New Music Track: While the new track is added, it’s currently set to mute—but stay tuned for some awesome tunes in the future! 🎶
[/list]
As always, your feedback helps shape the game, so let me know what you think of the changes. Thanks for playing and for being part of the community!

notes.title: v0.0.49 - 🚀 Update: Global Stats Improvements & Ball Buster Mode! 🏆
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

Another exciting update is here! I’m happy to announce some big improvements and additions:

What’s New:

Global Stats Improvements: I’ve made several tweaks to improve global stat tracking across all modes, making your progress more precise and rewarding.
Ball Buster Mode Now Live: The Ball Buster Mode is fully functional with stats and leaderboard integration! How many points can you rack up with just 10 balls? Test your precision and climb the ranks! 🏅
Minor Bug Fixes: A few pesky bugs have been squashed to make sure everything runs smoothly.
Your feedback continues to be incredibly valuable—keep it coming! Thanks for playing, and enjoy the new updates!

notes.title: v0.0.48 - ⚡️ Update: Blitz Baller Mode Enhancements & New Steam Stats! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m excited to roll out another update with some cool new features and improvements, especially for all you Blitz Baller Mode fans! Here’s what’s new:

What’s New:

Improved Blitz Baller Mode Ranking: Your rank in Blitz Baller Mode is now more accurate and competitive, giving you a better sense of where you stand!
New Steam Stats in Blitz Baller Mode: Now tracking total score, hits, balls won, time played, and balls fired. Compete with friends and see your stats climb!
Accumulative Stats Across All Modes: I’m laying the foundation for tracking total score, hits, balls won, time played, and balls fired across ALL game modes. This is still in the works, but the groundwork is in place!
As always, your feedback and suggestions are super valuable as I continue building the game. Let me know what you think of the new updates and stay tuned for more improvements soon!

Thanks for playing and being part of the community!

notes.title: v0.0.46 - 🎉 New Update: Experimental Linux Support Added! 🐧
notes.notes:
Linux support has been added, though it’s still in experimental stages! 🐧 While we're still in Early Access, I wanted to open the door for Linux players to join the fun. Since it’s experimental, some features may need further tweaking – but I’m eager to hear your feedback!

What’s New:

Experimental Linux Support: You can now play on Linux, but keep in mind that it’s in the early stages of testing. I’ll be actively working on optimizations based on your feedback.
Minor Fixes: Continued improvements to the Global Rank display and general performance tweaks.
As always, I appreciate your patience and feedback, especially as I expand to new platforms! If you run into any issues with the Linux version or have suggestions, let me know.

Thanks for playing, and welcome to all the new Linux players!

notes.title: v0.0.45 - 🔧 Minor Update: Global Rank Display Fix! 🌍
notes.notes:
I’ve just rolled out a small update that fixes an issue with the Global Rank not displaying correctly on the stats page. Now, your Global Rank will show up accurately after each game in Blitz Baller mode, so you can better track your progress and climb the leaderboard! 🏆

What’s Fixed:

Global Rank Display: Fixed an issue where the Global Rank wasn’t showing properly on the stats page.
Minor tweaks and optimizations for a smoother experience.
As always, I appreciate your support and feedback! If you run into any more issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out.

Thanks for playing and good luck climbing those ranks!

notes.title: v0.0.44 - 🌟 Small Update: Global Rank Added to Stats Page! 🌍
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

I’m excited to bring you a small but important update: Global Rank is now live on Blitz Baller mode's Game Over stats page! After each game, you’ll see how your score compares to players worldwide. Climb the leaderboard and aim for the top spot! 🏆

What’s New?

Global Rank: Now displayed on the stats page after each Blitz Baller game, so you can see where you stand globally.
Minor bug fixes and performance improvements to enhance your experience.
Currently, Global Rank is available exclusively in Blitz Baller mode, but stay tuned for future updates that may expand this feature to other modes!

Thanks for playing, and as always, your feedback is appreciated. Good luck climbing the ranks!

notes.title: v0.0.43 - 🚀 New Update: Now Featuring Spanish and Japanese Localization! 🌍
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🎉

I'm excited to roll out a brand new update that brings Spanish (es) and Japanese (ja) localization to the game! Now you can enjoy all the ball-bouncing, score-racking fun in your preferred language! Whether you're aiming for the top of the leaderboard or just enjoying the chaos, I want to ensure you can do it in the most comfortable language.

What’s New?

Localization for Spanish (es): All menus, prompts, and key gameplay elements are now available in Spanish.
Localization for Japanese (ja): I've added Japanese support so you can dive into the action with complete localization.
Bug Fixes & Improvements: I’ve squashed a few bugs and made some performance tweaks to ensure a smoother gaming experience.

I'm super grateful for all your support and feedback. Feel free to message me on the forums or my Discord if you run into any issues or have any suggestions.

Thank you for playing and being part of the journey. 🌟

Spanish and Japanese are not languages I know, so there are likely errors. Let me know if I need to make language changes or additional information.
